hypothesis: The R2 reservoir water operator can be transferred to TN as an exactly conservative, perfectly mixed daily mass carrier without changing the registered land-N equations.

daily_mass_allocation.fast_N: distributed within each month in proportion to local_fast_response_m3_s
daily_mass_allocation.slow_N: distributed within each month in proportion to local_slow_response_m3_s
daily_mass_allocation.zero_path_flow: monthly path N must also be numerically zero; otherwise fail

channel_operator.geometry_source: Andreadis width and registered Reach length

reservoir_operator.capture_and_bypass: locked R2 control edge and local_capture_fraction
reservoir_operator.mixing: complete mixing of prior TN stock and current captured TN
reservoir_operator.initial_TN_stock: zero on 2006-01-01 with parameter-dependent 2006-2009 TN warm-up; sensitivity audited in 2016

hard_checks: disabled reservoir mode reproduces the old monthly channel router
enabled carrier closes total TN input = channel removal + terminal export + final reservoir stock
all reservoir stocks and releases are finite and nonnegative
no-reservoir and enabled paths share the same local TN mass
2016 predictions are insensitive to registered alternative 2006 initial TN stocks
